findings.message: recorded for Weigh-In, which is not installed to show it (WEIGHIN_BIN names no file: <root>/no-weighin-here)

proves: fan-out: the frontier has at least 3 independent tickets; park: Weigh-In's contract accepted the request and the store holds it once, for a weighin that folds requests into the same store; rule: the ruling was recorded
does_not_prove: that the tickets are worth running in parallel, that the call was one-way, that a human has seen the request, or that the ruling is right
